notes: Fixed LoggerDB.get_addon_events(): the WHERE clause matched any cycle_logs row with 'ADD' in outcome/signal_type, so SKIPPED/BLOCKED/CANDLE_GATE_SKIP re-evaluations of the same signal appeared as separate dashboard addon markers alongside real fills. Confirmed live on VPS logs.db: XAU/USDC had 822 CANDLE_GATE_SKIP_HIGH_RISK_ADD_SHORT + 436 BLOCKED_HIGH_RISK_ADD_LONG rows vs only 3 real EXECUTED_HIGH_RISK_ADD_SHORT fills -- chart showed ~9 +ADD markers in a 50-min window where 0 real adds executed. Fix narrows the query to outcome LIKE 'EXECUTED%ADD%'. Pure backend/query fix, no schema/API contract change. 2 new direct LoggerDB/sqlite tests (not mocked). Full suite: 439 passed, 2 failed -- both pre-existing/unrelated (configured_symbols_store global test-isolation issue, documented in PR #63 and CHANGELOG 0.48.6), reproduced identically before this change.
